reviews.review: She Earth on my Defense till I forces
Oh we are the valiant infantry we are the alpha team with passion and camradery

Simultaneously the best and worst EDF I've played. Definitely quantity over quality, it's very padded out. 116 missions, and to get every achievement you need to beat every mission on the hardest difficulty with all the classes. The hardest difficultly can only be unlocked after beating all the missions. So to get 100% you have to beat all 116 missions a minimum of 5 times, the first time to unlocked the hardest mode, then another 4 times for each class. So you have to play 580 missions total, if you're playing online with others there is no guarantee you'll get to do your missions. Minimum of 160 hours of playtime.

Many missions are pointless existing only to show you one singular new enemy type. It'll last 5 minutes then you'll continue onto the next mission. So for 5 missions it'll be new enemy variants then the next 5 are real missions that progressively get harder until a random difficulty spike. It is genuinely tiresome. At this point my group is beating it out of spite. The mission list has about 40 missions that are genuinely pointless, only serving to give us a couple lines of dialog. A few bosses are encountered multiple times (6 or so for Achelus). 

The game would have seriously benefited from having all of the monster introduction missions merged into another mission. The vast majority of these missions are time wasters. More isn't always better and this EDF doesn't do enough different from the rest of the series warrant having so many missions. Some people see it as value, I see it as a game that's 90% padding and then to release 6 which is just a best of list from this game is insulting.

I thought EDF 4.1 was great and this one is much better, with surprises in store for those who played EDF 4.1. The ability to change playable classes and weapon loadouts before each mission, and the sheer amount of weapon loadout combinations lets me experiment with tackling the myriad of missions any number of ways, though ultimately it's kill or be killed. It's a really fun game with some tough levels, the weapons and destruction are insane fun and unrealistic, the banter between friendly units often cheesy and comical, and the comedy is endearing.
